title: Viewing reminder the day before
description: Send a day-before reminder for a property viewing on WhatsApp with time, address and what to bring. Cuts no-shows for agents.
notes: Send 18 to 24 hours ahead. Add parking or entry instructions; practical details keep it utility.

body.text: Reminder: your viewing at *{{address}}* is tomorrow at {{time}}. Please bring a photo ID. Reply here if you need to change the time.
